author: Mark Atwood
text: Blocked on JMAP-826m.8. Same reasoning as JMAP-826m.25: this bead asks for a shared dedup-walker refactor, but the canonical-or-divergent dedup-algorithm decision in JMAP-826m.8 changes what the refactor target should be (a shared closure walker over the current 'retain + contains' algorithm vs. a port of mail-server's IdFate HashMap-based algorithm). Tackling both .24 and .25 together once .8 is decided is the right sequencing.
